quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark and Elise Stads become controlling owners of the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Mark Stad and his wife Elise are now the controlling owners of the Timberwolves.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Mark Stad and his wife Elise are now the controlling owners of the Timberwolves. The Stad family was invested as minority owners the last two-plus years along with Mark Lore and Alex Rodriguez. As far as it's been told to me, Mark and Alex have really grown to love the minority partnership with Mark Stad.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What can you tell us and the audience about the fact that the Wolves have a new majority owner now in the Stad family?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Rodriguez remains the public face of the Timberwolves ownership
quotes.excerpt: Alex Rodriguez is still going to be the public face of the ownership group.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Alex Rodriguez is still going to be the public face of the ownership group. He is the one who has the house here. He is the one who is omnipresent. He is the one who has rock-solid relationships with the front office and with the players. Mark and his wife are going to still reside in California. There are no thoughts of buying a house here. I am sure they will be present at times. Mark Lore will still be present, but he has other business happenings monopolizing his time.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What can you tell us and the audience about the fact that the Wolves have a new majority owner now in the Stad family?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Timberwolves still need a new arena regardless of ownership
quotes.excerpt: They still need a new arena, regardless of who the majority owner is.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: They still need a new arena, regardless of who the majority owner is. Outside of the New Orleans arena, they have the worst arena in the league. Matt Caldwell was brought in from the Florida Panthers. He will continue to try to steer in the right direction for a shovel to go in the ground for them to get a new arena. They are hoping for that Nicollet Mall site. I was told unlikely on the farmers market site.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: If you are a fan, how does this impact you?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves ownership remains committed to paying the luxury tax
quotes.excerpt: Mark and Alex have been willing the last couple years to greenlight some of the most expensive teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Mark and Alex have been willing the last couple years to greenlight some of the most expensive teams in the NBA because you can go up into the aprons and you wind up paying tax. So they have greenlit some of the most expensive basketball teams in the NBA the last few years. But I think functionally and strategically, they will have to get out of the aprons for at least a season to avoid for sure to unlock one of their early 2030s draft picks and to just avoid further penalties.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: Are they willing to spend money?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Stad's active involvement in Timberwolves ownership
quotes.excerpt: Mark Stad is also busy running a tech investment firm, but it sounds like he will be involved.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Mark Stad is also busy running a tech investment firm, but it sounds like he will be right there with ideas and in an aggressive nature, while Alex is sort of more of the front-facing partner in this thing. And Mark Lore still remains a minority investor who is going to be involved on some front and will be there as, you know, just part of the group of rich people that make decisions for the Timberwolves.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What can you tell us and the audience about the fact that the Wolves have a new majority owner now in the Stad family?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Connelly's future with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: The other elephant in the room is Tim Connelly's future, considering his relationship with Alex Rodriguez.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Next to the arena, the other elephant in the room is Tim Connelly's future, considering his relationship with Alex Rodriguez. I think Tim is here. I don't know where Tim is going. I think he wants to see this thing through. You make the big deal for LaMelo Ball, give this a couple years, see what this roster looks like. So I guess I will be surprised, just because of Tim's involvement, Tim increasing his ownership stake slightly, the fact that Tim is here a ton, has the house here. I think Tim ends up re-upping.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What about Tim Connelly's future?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cheryl Reeve's recent conversations with ownership
quotes.excerpt: Cheryl Reeve spoke pregame on Monday. She noted she had a long conversation with Alex on Sunday.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Cheryl Reeve spoke pregame on Monday. She noted she had a long conversation with Alex on Sunday, spoke with Mark Stad the other day. And I just think Cheryl is brilliant. I'm a huge Cheryl Reeve fan. And maybe I'm just trying to read the body language of when she was at the podium pregame on Monday and all that, but she seemed pretty excited. She chooses her words very carefully, and I sensed some enthusiasm.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What about Tim Connelly's future?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.excerpt: The Timberwolves were 28th out of 30 teams with a valuation of $3.6 billion.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: The last time Forbes put out their list, which was January 8th, 2026, they do the annual team valuation rankings, and the Timberwolves were 28th out of 30 teams with a valuation of $3.6 billion, which is still $2 billion higher than the sale price after the four-year layaway plan, Glenn Taylor to Mark Lore, Alex Rodriguez.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What do you make of the $4.5 billion valuation on the sale price here?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga's fit with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I'm a little skeptical about Kuminga's fit even if he were to decide to take a bet.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: Our guy Windy, your guy Windy, friend of the show Brian Windhorst, he kind of kept the Timberwolves Jonathan Kuminga steam alive. I'm a little skeptical about Kuminga's fit even if he were to decide to just kind of take a bet on yourself deal with the Timberwolves. He's not a great shooter, but maybe if he's being teed up for better shots, I would feel a little more comfortable with a lower volume, lower usage role player. Kuminga feels like he's trying to become a star and prove himself for maybe another contract.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: What about Jonathan Kuminga?

quotes.speaker: Darren Wolfson
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves roster spots and potential signings
quotes.excerpt: They have the two open roster spots. They have to fill one of them.

text_blocks.speaker: Darren Wolfson
text_blocks.text: They have the two open roster spots. They have to fill one of them. You can keep, so there's 15 roster spots and then three two-way players. Obviously, you could, if you needed another big on the roster, you could, you could convert one of those two-way guys to a standard deal. If they wanted to just sign a player for that 14th spot, they could spend up to $3.9 million. That's what, so they're $3.9 million below the second apron, so to, because and they are hard-capped at the second apron regardless.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: Do they need to fill the spot?
